HybridMount.NET third-party source and redistribution notes (0.0.25.2)

The MIT LICENSE applies to original HybridMount.NET code and documentation.
It does not relicense dependencies, Microsoft binaries, system fonts, or third-party assets.
Exact resolved versions and development-only scope are in Dependencies.txt.

Resolved/<id>/<version> retains original NuGet license and NOTICE documents.
For packages declaring MIT or Apache-2.0 without a license file, License.txt
retains the declared terms and available nuspec copyright. Supplied original
texts are not rewritten or translated.

AWS SDK Core 4.0.102.14, S3 4.0.104.7, SQS 4.0.100.21: Apache-2.0.
Existing AWSSDK/License.txt and Notice.txt remain. Additional unmodified official
upstream texts are in Resolved/AWSSDK.Core/4.0.102.14/UPSTREAM-*.txt, from:
https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-net/tree/80697dc1074776fd534d331cfa817f6741b32556
This is a recorded upstream snapshot, not a claim that these files were in those nupkg archives.
Apache patent grants, patent-litigation termination, NOTICE, and trademark limits apply.

SQLitePCLRaw wrapper/build packages 2.1.12: Apache-2.0. Original NOTICE source:
https://github.com/ericsink/SQLitePCL.raw/blob/v2.1.12/NOTICE.TXT
SQLite core: public domain, https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html
Actual e_sqlite3.dll payload reports SQLite 3.53.3, source ID:
2026-06-26 20:14:12 d4c0e51e4aeb96955b99185ab9cde75c339e2c29c3f3f12428d364a10d782c62
Both architecture DLLs match the nupkg entries and contain that source ID.
Optional components in aggregate notices are not proof that they are linked.

WebDAVClient 3.3.0 is MIT: keep its exact LICENSE and provenance NOTICE.
Historical CC0 and the archived combined MIT/Apache file are not a current dual-license offer.
nlohmann/json 3.12.0 is MIT: the vendored header and complete license remain.

.NET runtime 10.0.12 original license and notices are retained for both architectures.
Full includes .NET and Windows App Runtime; Small requires shared runtimes separately
but still contains the .NET apphost and SDK-selected managed/bootstrap files.
Windows App SDK and WinUI binary redistribution follows the supplied Microsoft terms.
Source project MIT declarations do not replace these binary terms, which require
significant application functionality, protection of Microsoft and notices, and
preserve trademark restrictions and third-party exceptions.
SDK notices include Eigen/MPL-2.0 and a source-code access route. References to GPL
as an MPL secondary-license definition do not make this application GPL-licensed.

WebView2 SDK license/NOTICE are retained. A separately installed WebView2 Runtime
has its own terms; no MIT grant is made for that runtime.
MSVC static runtime object code (/MT) follows Visual Studio redistribution terms:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/releases/2026/redistribution
https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/vs2026-ga-visualcpp-v14-redist-runtime/
Build/test tools are not redistributed as application binaries. Windows system APIs
and installed Segoe icon fonts are prerequisites; no system font files are shipped.
No third-party rights are replaced by the repository MIT license or this inventory.
